mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (user_id, title, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, created_at FROM conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id}
